searchText: <@!203220829473996800> may follow ethereum.org template, role oriented. set up 2 roles: developer, staker. Because different actors have different interests. developer normally won't bother staking operation, while stakers don't have to code, just need to know enough of how eth2 works, but need to go very deep on operation. I encourage a validator and developer dedicated section - different actors with different intentions - both equally important to its success Can't put everything in one document, think I'll focus on developers first. We need more protocol devs. More material for stakers comes when we're deeper into testnets
